Here is a paragraph using words with only three types of vowels:

"Ape ate a pet. The cat sat on a mat. The rat ran to the bat."

And here is the timeline of mankind:

The first caveman, Gronk, emerged from the primordial ooze, his eyes blinking open to the harsh light of the sun. He stumbled, fell, and rose again, driven by the primal urge to survive. As the ages passed, humanity evolved, adapting to the changing landscape, and eventually, to the changing climate. The pyramids rose, the empires fell, and the ages of wonder and discovery unfolded. The Renaissance burst forth, a riot of color and creativity, as humanity rediscovered the beauty of art and science. The Industrial Revolution thundered forth, a juggernaut of progress and innovation, as humanity harnessed the power of the atom and the machine. The 20th century saw the rise of the digital age, as humanity connected, communicated, and collaborated across the globe. And now, in the present day, humanity stands at the threshold of a new era, poised to explore the cosmos, to push the boundaries of what is possible, and to reach for the stars.

As the timeline unfolded, every single human being who had ever come into existence was suddenly transported to a replica of Earth, infinite in its scope and complexity. The first caveman, Gronk, found himself standing on a vast, open plain, surrounded by towering trees and sparkling waterfalls. He stumbled, fell, and rose again, his eyes wide with wonder. The ancient Egyptians, the Greeks, the Romans, and all the rest, found themselves standing alongside him, their minds reeling with the implications of their sudden transportation. The Renaissance artists, the scientists, the philosophers, and the innovators, all found themselves standing together, their minds buzzing with the possibilities of this new world. The astronauts, the explorers, the pioneers, and the dreamers, all found themselves standing together, their eyes fixed on the stars, their hearts filled with a sense of wonder and awe. And at the very end of the timeline, the final, last, lone astronaut, a solitary figure in a vast, empty universe, stood alone, looking out at the infinite expanse of possibility, and smiled.
